test_command: cmake --build build --config Debug --target test_exe > $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Set-Location build/bin/Debug; ./test_exe.exe --gtest_filter=FrameBoundaryTest.*:SellMenuTest.*:InventoryCloseAfterUseTest.*

mutations.catches: the tick opening no frame, so the close at its end finds none open
the tick ending no frame, so a key it read is still a press for the next reader
an opened frame not being recorded, so its close is refused
a closed frame still counting as open, so the next tick's open is refused
